title: Ship judges checks by name and App id and every required context
body:
Source: operator-forwarded weekly code review 2026-11-19 (800 PRs since 2026-11-12, deep pass on ship gate, lane write guard, CI). Evidence: newestCheck matches by name only and ignores the App id (src/ci/ship.ts:99) while selectRequiredCheck checks both; requiredContext takes the first required context only (src/repo/required-check.ts:148); lane-target: / admits every path with no sanity check (src/hook/scope.ts:91-109).
Files: src/ci/ship.ts, src/repo/required-check.ts, src/hook/scope.ts
Outcome: the close record and open-red limit pick the check by name and App id; a repository requiring several contexts is judged on all of them; a lane-target naming / or a path above the main checkout is refused.
Proof: `node --test test/ci/ship.test.ts: pass` with a same-name check from another App ignored and two required contexts both judged.
